clips.place: wooden temple veranda on tall timber stilts above a maple valley
clips.keyframe_prompt: A grand old wooden temple hall with a wide timber veranda built on tall criss-crossed wooden stilts, perched on a hillside above a deep valley filled with blazing red and orange maple trees, soft morning mist in the valley, the city faint in the far distance, seen from across the valley, no people

Thin morning mist drifts slowly through the valley below. The temple hall and its stilts stand solid in the soft light.

Sound: morning birdsong, a distant temple bell.

clips.keyframe_prompt: A quiet Kyoto temple moss garden: soft green moss carpet, an old weathered stone lantern beside a still small pond, a scattering of bright red maple leaves on the moss and floating on the dark water, a red maple branch hanging into the top of frame, dappled light, low eye-level view, no people

Locked-off camera, no movement.

clips.keyframe_prompt: A narrow Kyoto stone-paved lane at blue-hour dusk, lined with dark wooden machiya townhouses with lattice fronts, warm paper lanterns glowing by the doorways, the stones slightly wet and reflecting the lantern light, a single maple tree with red leaves at the end of the lane, centred one-point perspective, no people, no readable writing on the lanterns

Slow, steady 5 cm dolly forward along the lane, then the camera holds still for the final second.
